steps.caption: Measurement reports
steps.narration: A measurement report can go straight onto a client's record. Here is how to import one.

steps.caption: Upload the PDF
steps.narration: Upload the report's PDF here, or paste the report's text in the box beside it.

steps.value:
Prepared for: Tunde Oyelaran
58 Wren Hollow Ln
Albany, NY 12203
tunde.oyelaran@example.com
Total Roof Area: 2,450 SF
Pitch: 6/12
Waste: 10%
steps.caption: Paste the text
steps.narration: We'll paste the text of a report for Tunde Oyelaran, a client in Albany, New York. It has his name, address and email, and the roof measurements.

steps.caption: Client
steps.narration: Review the import shows what was read. First the client: name, email and address.

steps.caption: Roof
steps.narration: Then the roof: squares, square feet, pitch and waste.

steps.caption: Draft
steps.narration: Nothing is filed yet. Until you confirm, the report is a draft.

steps.caption: Existing client matched
steps.narration: The CRM found Tunde by his email, so it says Existing client matched. No duplicate is made.

steps.caption: Report filed
steps.narration: The report is filed on his record, and it shows in his client portal too.

steps.caption: Menu: Settings
steps.narration: To get here, open Settings in the menu, then Measurement reports.

youtube.title: How to import a measurement report | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Measurement reports in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will paste a report's text, review the client and roof measurements that were read from it, and confirm. The report is filed on the matching client.
